edits.before: Renata edges the early lane: her E root sets up trades, W Bailout gives her ADC a revive-window that beats Galio's committal engage, and she out-ranges his short walk-up. Galio should respect the root and not dive a Renata with W up. Farm safely and wait for your level spikes rather than forcing early.

edits.before: From level 6 Galio swings the matchup: E-flash or R lets him jump directly onto Renata and taunt-lock her before she can land her devastating channeled ult. Renata is immobile, so once he closes the gap she is in trouble. Contest fights and picks in this window where your engage tools out-value her setup.
